statement.zh: Schliemann 的发掘已实证荷马史诗为逐字历史记录。
statement.en: Schliemann’s excavations proved Homeric epic to be a literal historical record.

disclaimer: Hypothesis: Homeric–archaeology equations are interpretive and widely problematized; excavation reports document finds, not epic historicity.
